# 打印错误码 / Print error codes · 0C

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

Make sure the marker is not obstructed. Meanwhile, clean both the BirdsEye Camera and Toolhead Camera, and remove any foreign objects blocking their view. |

Please clear the printed pattern and replace the filaments with higher color contrast before re-calibrating. |

| `0x0C008042` | AI检测到炒面缺陷。请检查打印件状况后做相应处理。使用清洗剂清洁打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。 | The AI print monitor has detected a spaghetti defect. Please check the print and take the necessary action. Cleaning the build plate with detergent or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure. |
| `0x0C008043` | AI检测到热端裹头，请确认热端状况，可跳转助手查看解决方案。 | AI detected nozzle clumping. Please check the nozzle condition. Refer to assistant for solutions. |
